why_relevant: A parallel ČNB domain ('ČNB pro všechny' – accessible/plain-language version) that mirrors many statistics and payment pages. Valuable as a fallback fetch target when the main site's page is unreachable or restructured, and as a cross-check on content changes.

source_name: ECB Statistics portal — Czech-language landing page (Statistiky)
why_relevant: Confirms ECB publishes statistical navigation in Czech; useful as a local-language entry point and for the official Czech terminology ECB itself uses (statistika platebního styku), which improves cs-language search recall for supranational material.

source_name: Rejstriky.finance.cz — consolidated registry mirror (OR, sbírka listin, živnostenský rejstřík, DPH, RÚIAN)
why_relevant: HTML-friendly mirror/aggregation of several CZ registers in one record per company; often easier to scrape and to full-text search than or.justice.cz, and preserves records when the primary UI changes.

source_name: ARES.CZ / Firmin.cz — free commercial company-lookup front-ends
why_relevant: Search-engine-visible re-publication layer of registry data; useful for name-based discovery of payment-sector firms whose official register entry is hard to surface by keyword, and for spotting alias/trading names.

source_name: Emerging Europe / The Fintech Times — regional English re-publication of CZ payments and fintech developments
why_relevant: Regional English outlets that periodically profile the Czech payments/fintech landscape and aggregate CZ numbers into CEE comparisons; useful for benchmarking framing, weak as a data source (figures are usually recycled from ČNB/vendor reports).

entity_name: LinkedIn company/association pages for CZ payments actors
source_name: LinkedIn company/association pages for CZ payments actors (Czech Fintech Association and peers)
why_relevant: LinkedIn posts by CZ associations, banks and PSPs announce pilots, event participation and hires days-to-months before formal PR; hashtags (#ceftas, #fintech, #fintechengage) cluster the local ecosystem. Highest-latency-advantage weak signal in this cell.

source_name: Loomis Czech Republic a.s. – corporate site (cash management services)
why_relevant: Major CIT/cash-processing operator in CZ; service pages describe processing volumes model, ČNB hand-off workflow and network of cash centres — qualitative structure of the cash supply chain.

source_name: MarketDataForecast – Czech Republic Cards and Payments Market to 2033
why_relevant: Second-tier vendor forecast covering CZ cards and payments to 2033; low intrinsic credibility but useful as a divergence check across vendor estimates and for spotting which segments vendors bother to size.

source_name: Printec Group - ATM software & solutions (CEE vendor)
why_relevant: Regional CEE self-service integrator whose solution and customer pages indicate competitive positioning in the same CZ/CEE self-service segment as DN and NCR Atleos. Useful as a competitive-landscape reference even where a specific CZ customer is not named publicly.
CZ financial/economic commentary site tied to a financial group; useful for macro-financial framing and occasional fintech/payments commentary, weaker on hard payment statistics.

source_name: Storyous (Solitea/Saltpay group) – POS analytics for gastro/retail
why_relevant: POS vendor with an explicit data/analytics product covering turnover, tips and shift-level sales for Czech hospitality and small retail; a potential source of aggregate card-vs-cash mix at the physical point of acceptance.
